James Anderson set to continue playing career in Italy with Napoli Knights in the Italia T10 league
James Anderson is now set to captain and co-own the Napoli Knights, one of six teams in the Italia T10 league; after international retirement, England great Anderson continued playing for Lancashire and captained the county this year but Lancashire elected not to renew his contract
Wednesday 28 October 2026 09:04, UK
James Anderson is set to continue his playing career in Italy.
He will captain and co-own the Napoli Knights, one of six teams in the Italia T10 league as the 44-year-old extends his career after being released by Lancashire, his club of 25 years.
Anderson, who played more than 400 times for England across all formats and took nearly 1,000 wickets, is a big name to join the format.
The Italia T10 league is a 10-over-a-side competition, which takes place over 12 days at the Roma Cricket Ground from November 18.
It was created by Nadeem Shahid, a former professional cricketer, and Aamir Akhtar, who helped set up the Everest Premier League in his native Nepal.
High-profile players such as Chris Gayle, Shaun Marsh and Dawid Malan will also feature, joined by members of the Italian national side who impressed earlier this year when they narrowly lost to England at the T20 World Cup.
"The potential for cricket in Italy made it a big draw," Shahid told Reuters. "One of the things that made it attractive is the Italian Olympic Committee beginning to take it seriously after it became an Olympic sport."
He noted: "Tickets will be free for all the matches, and there will be coaching clinics on the sidelines."
Anderson's company, Activate Sport & Leisure, will be involved in some of those clinics, as Italy looks to develop homegrown talent capable of competing at Olympic level by the time of the 2032 Games in Brisbane.
"Of course, we want Napoli Knights to be competitive and challenge for the title, but we also want to contribute to something that continues to grow well beyond the tournament itself," Anderson said.
digest_he:
שחקן הקריקט הבריטי ג'יימס אנדרסון ממשיך את קריירת המשחק הפעילה שלו באיטליה. לאחר פרישתו מהנבחרת הלאומית וסיום דרכו הממושכת בלנקשייר, אנדרסון בן הארבעים וארבע יחזיק בתפקיד כפול כקפטן וכשותף בבעלות על קבוצת נאפולי נייטס מהליגה האיטלקית החדשה.

הליגה המדוברת מתקיימת במסגרת מקוצרת של עשרה אובר לכל צד במגרש הרומאי, וצפויה לארח כוכבי קריקט בינלאומיים נוספים. המהלך נועד לחזק את הענף באיטליה, לקדם כישרונות מקומיים צעירים לקראת המשחקים האולימפיים בבריזביין ולפתח את תשתית המשחק במדינה בסיוע מיזמים שונים.
